focus_tree = {
	id = nested_logic_tree

	focus = {
		id = logic_root
		x = 0
		y = 0
		cost = 10
	}

	focus = {
		id = logic_alt
		x = 2
		y = 0
		cost = 10
	}

	focus = {
		id = logic_child
		x = 1
		y = 1
		cost = 10

		prerequisite = {
			OR = {
				focus = logic_root
				focus = logic_alt
			}
		}

		available = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_government = fascism
					has_war_support > 0.3
				}
				AND = {
					has_government = communism
					NOT = {
						has_dlc = "Waking the Tiger"
					}
				}
			}
			NOT = {
				OR = {
					has_completed_focus = logic_alt
					has_country_flag = blocked
				}
			}
		}

		bypass = {
			has_completed_focus = logic_root
		}

		visible = {
			always = yes
		}
	}
}
